🇵🇸❤️⚖️🇪🇸🇵🇸 This is the real deal; it’s no ripoff!
Nov 2024 • Solo
Entirely vegan café and brunch-style restaurant which offers a huge range of mains - including plant-based pizzas. The menu is 🇵🇸clear on ingredients - labelling each item and marking those that contain gluten - and providing additional information too. 🇿🇦🇵🇸The desserts can be low in sugar. I’ve had the sweet potato chocolate brownie, and that certainly will control your glycemic reaction. 🕊️⚖️🌏⚖️ Out of the centre of HCMC and halfway down a pleasantly quiet street. Welcoming to all🇵🇸⚖️!

An oasis of delicious food in busy Thao Dien
Nov 2020
Zeroism is one of my favourite places here in Saigon and definitely in D2. 
I have come with my three small children and my husband and alone, then met a friend. Each time a different experience, but all blissfully calm. 

The WiFi is strong (essential for laptop work), the coffee is incredible - I recommend the cocoa latte with cashew milk, and the food is delicious. Quiet jazz music and super polite and helpful when I brought the kids in too. 

It's definitely one of my favourite finds here. And the carrot bagel has become my go-to comfort food.
